name: Couple Sleeping
steps: Match the sideways-sleeping girl with the straight boy. Match the curved girl with the curled-up boy.
Match the girl resting on his shoulder with the sleeping boy.
Match the pink-nightgown girl under the spread-out boy’s arm.
Match the spooning girl with the boy facing away.
Match the crescent-shaped girl with the backward-curved boy.
Match the small girl lying on the muscular boy’s chest.
Match the upside-down girl to form a heart shape with the boy.
Match the hugging girl with the boy curled into a ball.
